method: a rail, powered rail, detector rail or activator rail at the cell origin with, on each side (north, east, south, west), no rail, a rail on the floor or a rail on a stone one block up (`sides`); `neighbours_first` sets the neighbours (with block updates) before the centre, `centre_first` after it; `reads` are [block, states] of the centre and then of each neighbour rail in side order, 2 ticks after the last change
